notes:
Built on Foundry v13's token movement system; verified on v14.

Breaking

Tokens are no longer mountable by default. Mounts are opt-in. Detection marks newly placed tokens by name, but does not run retroactively — anything already on a scene must be marked in Token Config → Identity → Mounting.

Movement

Riders now follow the mount's actual route, not a straight line to its endpoint. Carrying moved from updateToken to moveToken: v14 collapses a whole route into a single update, which took the previous approximation with it.

  • Only user-placed waypoints are replayed. Core's generated intermediate steps, replayed as real waypoints, made riders crawl the grid square by square while the mount glided over the corners actually drawn.
  • autoRotate is passed explicitly. Core resolves it from the movement method and defaults api moves to false, so carried riders never turned with their mount.

New

  • Steering — drag the rider in seat 0 and the mount follows, tracing the route you drew. Passengers are held in place.
  • Drag to mount — drop one token onto another to mount it. World setting with a per-token override.
  • Per-token options — rider capacity, can be mounted, can ride, drag-target and ownership-grant overrides, each falling back to its world setting.
  • Mount recognition — tokens are marked mountable by name as they are placed. The list is editable; matching is whole-word, so horse does not fire on Horseshoe Crab.

Full details in the release notes.
